sar.narrative: This report concerns fraudulent activity identified on account C12382, specifically involving unauthorized transaction T3514030 totaling $287.50. The customer confirmed they did not authorize this transaction, which was processed via a card-not-present channel. Internal graph analysis revealed that the transaction originated from device profile dp_14030, which is currently associated with multiple other cards and exhibits suspicious patterns across various billing regions and email domains. This shared device profile indicates a coordinated effort to utilize compromised credentials across our platform. Given the association with a known high-risk device profile and the confirmed unauthorized nature of the transaction, this activity is indicative of organized account takeover or card-not-present fraud. We have blocked the affected card and initiated monitoring on all other accounts linked to the identified device profile to prevent further unauthorized access. The institution is filing this report to document the potential systemic risk posed by the shared device infrastructure. We continue to investigate the broader network of accounts associated with dp_14030 to mitigate further financial exposure.
